title: OpenAI Reportedly Raises $11 Billion in Ongoing Funding Round
excerpt: Artificial intelligence developer OpenAI has reportedly secured an additional $11 billion in a funding round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion.
body_html:
Artificial intelligence company OpenAI has reportedly brought in another $11 billion through a funding round that remains open, according to reports. The ongoing financial arrangement values the organization at $1.25 trillion.

While the funding round has not yet officially closed, expectations point to finalization in the coming weeks. Additional details regarding the participants in the round or specific terms of the agreement were not provided as the process continues toward completion.
